## Privacy

This website does not use cookies, tracking or analytics. Fonts are served from this site; no data is sent to Google Fonts or other third parties. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which processes server log data (e.g. IP addresses) to deliver the site; see the [GitHub General Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## EU funding
